stem: A moisture sensor is moved into a different substrate. What should happen before its raw value is treated as an absolute target?
choices: Reuse the old substrate target unchanged.
Increase irrigation until the raw number matches the previous media.
Verify installation and substrate-specific behavior/reference so the trend has appropriate context.
Ignore crop stage because sensor output is universal.
rationale: Verify installation and substrate-specific behavior/reference so the trend has appropriate context.
